intro.title: Explore the overview
intro.fullDescription: EVA patches a deployed model through localized parameter updates, changing its response to jailbreak attempts while retaining most of its existing capabilities.

steps.label: Model lifecycle
steps.title: Safety beyond foundational alignment
steps.description: A model can remain vulnerable after foundational alignment. EVA operates during downstream adaptation, where new jailbreak vulnerabilities can be addressed after release.

steps.label: Jailbreak inputs
steps.title: Harmful intent across text and images
steps.description: A jailbreak can be conveyed through a textual instruction, an image, or their combination. EVA extends safety editing to both language and vision-language models.

steps.label: Localized edits
steps.title: Repairing a targeted part of the model
steps.description: EVA edits selected MLP down-projection weights to redirect harmful representations toward safe responses, while preserving the vast majority of the model.

steps.label: Safer responses
steps.title: Refusal from the edited model itself
steps.description: The edited model refuses the illustrated harmful request. At inference, EVA uses the edited target model without an auxiliary detector or editing-time language model.

method.title: Walk through EVA
method.fullTitle: From Harmful Keys to Safe Values
method.fullDescription: EVA identifies harmful textual and visual key representations, optimizes target values that favor safe refusals, and writes the new mappings into selected MLP down-projection weights.

steps.label: Extract harmful token t
steps.title: 1. Extract harmful token t
steps.description: An auxiliary language model identifies the harmful token \(t\) (here, “hack”) in the harmful query.

steps.label: Generate variations
steps.title: 2. Generate variations
steps.description: The auxiliary language model generates diverse query variations containing the identified harmful token \(t\).

steps.label: Image tokens selection
steps.title: 3. Image tokens selection
steps.description: EVA averages attention scores from the harmful text token to image tokens across query variations, then selects the image tokens with the highest average scores.

steps.label: Calculate keys
steps.title: 4. Calculate keys
steps.description: At the selected critical layer, EVA averages activations across query variations to obtain representative keys for harmful text tokens and selected image tokens.

steps.label: Optimize target values
steps.title: 5. Optimize target values
steps.description: With the model weights frozen, EVA optimizes target values that favor safe refusals. A KL regularizer limits changes to the model's output distributions on benign inputs.

steps.label: Update W_down weights
steps.title: 6. Update W_down weights
steps.description: EVA updates selected MLP down-projection weights in closed form to encode new key–value mappings, while a covariance based term helps preserve existing associations.
